title: Synthesis and characterization of [Ce(BTC)]-MOF based capacitive and impedimetric dual-mode relative humidity sensor
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48478-48486
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06933E, Paper
Open Access

The manuscript reports on the development of a dual-mode (capacitive and impedimetric) relative humidity sensor utilizing a highly crystalline and porous Ce(BTC)-MOF thin film.
